Terms of Service

1. What Fixvice is. Fixvice is a listings platform that lets individuals and businesses publish service listings ("Listings") so that other users can find and contact them. Fixvice does not perform, supervise, or guarantee the quality of any service listed. Any agreement to perform work is strictly between the person offering the service and the person contacting them.

2. Accounts and signing in. To publish a Listing, message other users, or browse by country and city, you need an account. An account has a username and a 6-digit number. The username must be unique: it is 3–10 characters (letters, digits, underscore, dot or hyphen; older accounts created before this limit may be up to 20), and it is the identity of your account across Fixvice (your Listings, your conversations, bans and sign-outs). The 6-digit number is not unique — several accounts may share the same number — and you sign in by entering your username and number together. When you create an account you must give a mobile number and may optionally add an email address. There is no separate password, so keep your username and number private: you are responsible for everything done through your account, and anyone who knows both can sign in as you. Once signed in, Fixvice keeps you signed in on that device and takes you straight back to the country and city you last browsed, until you sign out, clear your browser's storage, or an administrator signs you out (see section 11).

3. Your profile. From your profile you can add a profile photo and a short "about you" text, and change your username, 6-digit number, mobile number and email address at any time. A new username must be available, must follow the rules in section 2, and must not be a banned username. If you change your username, your existing Listings and conversations are moved to the new username. Do not use a username, photo or text that impersonates another person or business, or that is offensive, misleading or illegal.

4. Free listings and optional paid boosts. Publishing a Listing on Fixvice is free. You can optionally pay to boost visibility: a one-time +50% boost for one service (€7.90), a one-time +100% boost for one service (€9.90), or Premium (€9 per week) that boosts all of your services. One-time boosts last 30 days. Where these are shown as "coming soon", payments are not yet live and nothing is charged; the price, duration and terms are always shown to you before you pay, and you are never charged without an action from you.

5. Cancelling. You may cancel Premium at any time, which stops future weekly charges. Cancelling does not refund amounts already charged. A one-time boost simply ends after its 30 days and does not renew.

6. Refund policy. Boost and Premium charges are non-refundable once billed. If you believe you were charged in error (for example, a charge occurred after you cancelled), contact us through the messaging feature or our helpline within 14 days and we will review it.

7. Listings, prices and categories. A Listing contains a business name, description, category, photo (and optionally a video), the countries and cities where you work, and a price. The price must be a whole number of at most 6 digits, shown in US dollars (USD), British pounds (GBP) or euros (EUR), and you may add a short note of up to 40 characters under it (for example "per hour" or "+ materials"). Prices are what you state and are shown as a "from" price; they are not a binding offer by Fixvice, and the final price is agreed between you and the customer. Choose the category that fits your service; the category "Other" is available if none fits. If your service is a regulated profession (for example legal or financial services), you are responsible for holding any licence or authorisation required.

8. Your content. You are responsible for the accuracy of the information, images, video, profile photo and text you upload. You must not publish content that is illegal, misleading, or that you do not have the rights to use. Fixvice may remove any Listing at its discretion. By submitting a Listing you confirm the content is your own or that you have permission to use it, and that the information provided is accurate to the best of your knowledge. You can delete your own Listings at any time.

9. Messaging. Users can contact a Listing through Fixvice's messaging feature. Each customer has their own separate conversation with the Listing's owner, which is visible to those two accounts (and to Fixvice administrators where needed to enforce these Terms or respond to a report). Messages are stored in our database. Do not share anything through messages that you would not want stored, and never send payment details or passwords.

10. Conduct. Users must communicate respectfully through the messaging feature. Harassment, fraud, or attempts to circumvent these Terms may result in removal of your Listings or account. If you use Fixvice to offer, advertise, or facilitate anything illegal under the laws that apply to you, or otherwise misuse the platform, Fixvice may remove the relevant Listings, suspend your access, and permanently ban your account (identified by your unique username) from the platform, without prior notice and without refund of any amounts already paid. Whether to ban, unban, suspend or delete an account is decided solely and entirely at the discretion of the Fixvice administrators, who are not required to give a reason or to follow any particular procedure, and whose decision is final.

11. Administrator actions. Fixvice administrators may, at their discretion and for the reasons in section 10, delete any Listing, delete an account, ban or unban a username, and immediately and remotely sign your account out of every device where it is currently logged in (a "forced logout"), in each case without prior notice. Banning is entirely up to the administrators. A forced logout does not by itself delete your account or your Listings, and you can normally sign back in unless your account has also been banned.

12. Limits on what you can write. To keep Fixvice fast and readable, every text box has a limit, shown in small text under the box. In general a field may contain at most 20 words. The exceptions are: a Listing description (at most 400 characters), a Listing price note (40 characters), a price (6 digits), your username (10 characters), your 6-digit number, your mobile number (20 characters), your email address (60 characters) and your "about you" text (300 characters). Text over a limit is cut off automatically. These limits do not apply to chat messages. Fixvice may change the limits at any time.

12a. Photos and detail forms in chat. You can send photos and request details (such as a full address and when someone can come) in the chat. Anything you send there is stored with the conversation and can be seen by the other person, so only share what you are comfortable sharing and only with people you trust. Do not send illegal content, or other people's personal details without their consent.

13. Sponsoring and Premium. Listings can be sponsored to be shown more prominently: a one-time +50% boost (€7.90), a one-time +100% boost (€9.90), or Premium (€9 per week) that sponsors all of your Listings. Boost percentages describe the intended increase in visibility and are not a guarantee of results. Where these are shown as "coming soon" they are not yet available, and the price, duration and terms will be shown to you before you pay.

14. Intellectual property. The Fixvice concept, name, design and software belong to Transform4Future Anna Madeleine Nordlund. If you copy or steal the idea, the design, or the content of Fixvice — or another user's Listing, photos or text — you can be sued. You keep the rights to what you upload, and you give Fixvice permission to store and display it on the platform for as long as your Listing is active.

15. No guarantee of service. Fixvice is provided "as is". We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability, that any Listing will result in business, that your data will always save to the server (a poor connection can cause a save to fail), or that any user you contact will respond or perform as described. Any figures, examples, or testimonials shown in the app are illustrative only and are not a promise of results.

16. Liability. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Fixvice is not liable for any damages, losses, or disputes arising from interactions between users, from unauthorised use of an account whose username and number were shared or guessed, or from services purchased or rendered as a result of a Listing.

17. Local laws. You are responsible for complying with the laws and regulations that apply to you and your Listing in your own country and city, including any licensing, tax, or consumer-protection requirements for the services you offer.

18. Privacy and cookies. How we handle your data, and the local storage we use to keep you signed in, is described in our Privacy Policy and Cookies Policy, which form part of these Terms.

19. Changes to these Terms. These Terms may be updated from time to time. Continued use of Fixvice after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

20. Contact. Questions about these Terms, billing, refunds, or your account can be directed through the app's messaging feature, or by calling our helpline at +47 413 74 773.

Privacy Policy

1. What we collect. When you create an account, we store your chosen username, your 6-digit account number, your mobile number, and — if you choose to provide them — an email address, a profile photo and a short "about you" text. When you publish a Listing, we store the business name, description, category, cities/countries, and any photo or video you upload. When you message another user, we store the text of that message. When you subscribe, payment is handled directly by Stripe — Fixvice does not see or store your full card number.

2. Why we collect it. We only collect what is needed to run the marketplace: to display your Listing, let other users contact you, and manage any boost or Premium you buy. We do not collect more personal data than necessary for these purposes, and we do not sell your data to third parties.

3. Where it's stored. Listing and message data is stored in our database (Supabase) so it can be shared across devices. Some settings may also be kept in your browser's local storage on your own device.

4. Third-party services. Fixvice uses Stripe to process payments and Supabase to store data. These providers may process data on our behalf under their own privacy policies. Fixvice does not currently use analytics or advertising trackers.

5. Your rights. You can delete your own Listings at any time from your profile, which removes their content from the marketplace. To request a full copy or deletion of your data, contact us using the details below.

6. Data retention. We keep your Listing and message data for as long as your account is active, or until you delete it.

7. Administrative account actions. To keep the platform safe and enforce these Terms, Fixvice administrators can see basic account and session information (such as your username and whether you are currently signed in) and can remotely sign an account out of all of its active sessions ("forced logout"), in addition to banning or unbanning an account. This is an administrative security measure, not a form of tracking, and is used for moderation and enforcement purposes only.

8. Changes. We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time; continued use of Fixvice after changes are posted means you accept the updated policy.

9. Contact. Questions about your data can be directed through the app's messaging feature, or by calling our helpline at +47 413 74 773.

Cookies & Local Storage Policy

1. We don't use tracking cookies. Fixvice does not use advertising or analytics cookies, and does not track you across other websites.

2. What we do store on your device. Fixvice uses your browser's local storage (not a traditional cookie) to remember essential things like your language preference and your subscription status, so the app works correctly when you return.

3. Third-party storage. If you complete a payment, Stripe's own checkout page may set its own cookies, governed by Stripe's privacy and cookie policy, not ours.

4. Managing storage. You can clear this local storage at any time through your browser's settings; doing so will sign you out of any active session in this app. Separately, a Fixvice administrator can also remotely end your active session(s) at any time (a "forced logout") for safety or Terms-enforcement reasons, as described in our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy — in that case the app will automatically sign you out the next time it checks your session, without you clearing anything yourself.

5. Contact. Questions about this policy can be directed through the app's messaging feature, or by calling our helpline at +47 413 74 773.

Fixvice uses your browser's local storage to remember your preferences and keep you signed in — no advertising trackers.
